title: Paperclip vs AionUI for Claude Code, Codex and OpenClaw
content: This video contrasts Paperclip and Ion UI as open-source solutions for managing multiple AI agents. Paperclip is an 'AI Company Operating System' addressing the 'infrastructure problem' via agent hierarchy, budget controls, and a heartbeat system for persistent state. Ion UI (or AionUI) focuses on the 'interface problem', providing a unified frontend with scheduling and platform integration for enhanced personal productivity. Both tools address different challenges, complement each other, and are open-source.

backlinks: **Paperclip:** Open-source for multi-agent coordination. Solves 'Momento Man' with 'heartbeat' scheduling. Budget caps prevent runaway costs. Immutable audit trail for all agent actions. Supports Multi-Company data isolation and is extensible via out-of-process plugin system and SDK. Roadmap includes a marketplace ('Clipart').

**Ion UI (AionUI):** Open-source for a unified agent interface. Supports >20 AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.). Natural language cron for scheduling. Integrates with notification platforms. Unified client to avoid separate windows and configs.
